name: Plant-Based Breakfast Swaps
instructions: Swap dairy milk for a fortified plant milk (soy milk has the closest protein profile) and eggs for a tofu scramble or overnight oats with nut butter.
Check that your plant milk is "fortified" -- look for added calcium, B12, and vitamin D on the label.
Add ground flaxseed or chia to oats for an easy plant-based omega-3 source.
Watch today's video for quick breakfast ideas you can adapt with plant-based swaps.
